body: Did it twice more. First checked the charter's own 'eight stale version banners' claim -- not confirmed, that's already fixed (proper #define EA_VERSION/EA_BUILD_ID, with a comment showing it was caught in a prior pass). Said so instead of manufacturing a fix. Found two real ones instead, both 'duplicated truth': WARRANT#101 -- 5 separate hardcoded 0.35 regularization-strength literals across fit-check/resample-check/plateau-check/PBO-reject/bracket-recheck, several of which I introduced myself earlier tonight without realizing it. Consolidated into one named constant. WARRANT#102 -- the same 2.5x-TP/1.5x-SL diagnostic bracket hardcoded independently 3 times inside the same function. Consolidated those too, but deliberately did NOT touch the other 11+ file-wide occurrences of that same 2.5/1.5 pair -- those are in functions I haven't read closely this session, and sweeping them blind isn't the same as verifying each one. Both fixes are pure renames, zero behavior change, compiled clean. Ledger at pass_82, source at WARRANT#102. Still waiting on the first live run of everything shipped tonight (WARRANT#91 through #102).
